Name: Nude Female Farmer (1.4 Compatible)
Author: RunDevilRun007
Description:
There isn't much to say here, I simply made a nude mod for the female player character that makes her nude and is compatible with 1.4 since 1.4 kind of broke the old mods. I think because they added pants.xnb. Not sure. But now it will work in 1.4 and up, till they break it again.

REQUIRES SMAPI AND CONTENT PATCHER. Also if you want to play as a male farmer at any point, you'll need to disable/delete this mod because it messes with the male model a bit.

If you want nude NPCs then I recommend this mod:  https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4425
At the time of writing this, the Farmer portion of this mod doesn't work, but the NPC portion works just fine.
